goal: Independently bind reference MIDI event time to exported WAV sample coordinates; not infer the best dev/reference alignment or certify a physical string.

existing_evidence.limit: These observed fields identify sequencer state, not an exported-frame event ledger. Do not infer that all official interfaces lack such a facility.
A difference between SMF duration and WAV duration cannot locate preroll, trimming, latency or tail padding individually.
A nonzero first frame is not a NoteOn marker. No threshold or cross-producer correlation may be tuned to force an origin.

stage_order.action: Read the exact official version export documentation and already recorded interface descriptions; seek an export start/trim/resampling rule or sequencer-event/export-frame binding with explicit authority. Do not launch the reference to search speculatively.
stage_order.required_output: Original documentation/record bytes and SHA256, exact version/configuration applicability, and a proposed event-to-frame mapping.
stage_order.stop: If no independent mapping authority is available, report origin_not_authenticated and stop before diagnostic capture. Extra WAVs alone do not solve the missing binding.

stage_order.action: Submit the finite control matrix, primary binding evidence source, expected integer-frame mapping and rejection rules for explicit approval.
stage_order.required_output: Approved scope/run identifier and Windows-MCP main-session per-action approval route.
stage_order.stop: No approval means no reference launch, MIDI generation for this plan, state mutation or export.

stage_order.action: Only after both prior stages pass, use the already-consumed MIDI69/velocity70 control and declared time shifts, unchanged official925/FXP/215-parameter baseline and private session protection.
stage_order.required_output: Raw SMFs, WAVs, event/export binding observations and state/lifecycle receipts, all in a fresh diagnostic root.
stage_order.stop: Any identity/protected-state/parameter mismatch, deadline breach, missing primary binding or unregistered export ends the attempt; close safely, do not replace or restart to obtain a pass.

stage_order.action: Verify event timestamps, integer sample mapping, trim/padding/resampling treatment and all repeated controls. Within-reference shift consistency may corroborate primary event-frame evidence; it cannot create absolute origin authority.
stage_order.required_output: authenticated only if every declared case has a uniquely determined sample mapping bound to its own WAV; otherwise origin_not_authenticated with all failures retained.
stage_order.stop: All outcomes end this bounded attempt. No posthoc threshold/shift choice, replacement cases or automatic next attempt.

proposed_diagnostic_domain.role: timing-only, already-consumed control; never independent acoustic holdout
proposed_diagnostic_domain.shift_rule: Add each declared delta to NoteOn, NoteOff and EOT, retain tempo and initial pedal reset at tick0. Fixed shifts chosen before capture, not from any acoustic error.
proposed_diagnostic_domain.go_no_go: This bounded diagnostic is the experiment that establishes the mapping, not a verification of a known mapping. It may start only after a separate diagnostic execution authorization and after the reviewed registration; stop on any identity, protection, parameter, deadline or mapping failure.

mapping_acceptance.time_origin: MIDI tick0 mapped into the export WAV coordinate; a negative MIDI-origin sample is allowed only if authoritative trimming evidence explains it and all needed events/windows remain in the file.
mapping_acceptance.formula: note_on_sample = midi_origin_sample + llround(note_on_seconds*output_rate), then window = note_on_sample + llround(relative_seconds*output_rate)
mapping_acceptance.rounding: Nonnegative half-away-from-zero; report integer half-open intervals. No int(float*rate) truncation.
mapping_acceptance.uncertainty: Evidence must select a unique integer start/stop for both W1 and W2; retain the full admissible origin interval. If multiple window boundaries remain possible, do not authenticate.
mapping_acceptance.repetition: Every registered session/variant must satisfy its declared mapping, with no fitted offset chosen per file to improve B or comparison error.
quality_not_criteria: successful B fit or spectral comparison

required_certificate_fields.not_a_certificate: This plan is not loadable as timing evidence; no authenticated result or example pass certificate is supplied.

prohibitions: Do not relabel an A4 dev_render_verification report as reference authentication.
Do not turn self-declared JSON flags into event-to-frame authority.
No production B/DSP/threshold changes, physical source claims, original file replacement or old verdict revision.
No automatic fallback to invasive instrumentation, system recording, trial workarounds or another reference version. Such a route requires a separate decision.

current_disposition.finding: 所审精确随附手册及官方9.2.5版本绑定回执未建立选定离线导出路径的事件—整数帧映射；不宣称所有官方接口都缺少该能力。旧9.1.2帮助、41方法清单和serve页面已排除，不外推为官方9.2.5规范。
current_disposition.stop_scope: 停止参考诊断采集和原点认证；其余只读 A5 契约工作继续。
